name: Glenn Miller Orchestra In Christmas Mood
description: The Glenn Miller Orchestra, directed by Ray McVay, performs a Christmas swing concert at Casa da Música.
longDescription:
The Glenn Miller Orchestra returns to Casa da Música for a special Christmas concert in Sala Suggia. Directed by Ray McVay, the big band performs swing classics such as "Moonlight Serenade", "In The Mood", "Tuxedo Junction", and "Chattanooga Choo Choo", alongside festive standards including "Santa Claus is coming to town" and "Jingle Bells".

The performance takes place on Sunday, 13 December 2026, at 21:30. Tickets range from €35.00 to €37.50, and the show is rated for ages 6 and older.

O concerto realiza-se no domingo, 13 de dezembro de 2026, às 21:30. Os bilhetes custam entre 35,00 € e 37,50 €, e o espetáculo é para maiores de 6 anos.
